design_archetype: The Performance Pro + Swiss High-Contrast Financial Analytics
target_audience: Indian stock market investors, equity researchers, quant analysts, and traders tracking foreign institutional liquidity
emotional_tone: Institutional rigor, high data density, authoritative, transparent, real-time command center

provenance_chip_system.visual_style: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400

grid_and_spacing.layout_type: Mode B: High Density Financial Dashboard
grid_and_spacing.container_max_width: max-w-[1600px] mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6

key_modules_hierarchy.title: Real-time EOD Market Indices & Net Liquidity Summary
key_modules_hierarchy.description: Displays NIFTY 50, NIFTY 500, NIFTY Bank, India VIX, FII Net Today, DII Net Today with percentage changes and persistence badges.

key_modules_hierarchy.title: Sector-wise FPI Flows (NSDL Fortnightly) [TOP PRIORITY]
key_modules_hierarchy.description: Ranked horizontal bar chart of sector inflows/outflows, 24-sector heatmap matrix, sector AUM weight vs flow trend, and sector momentum filters.

key_modules_hierarchy.title: Daily FII/DII Net Flow & Cumulative Liquidity Trend
key_modules_hierarchy.description: Interactive time-series (Buy/Sell/Net) with cumulative flow overlay, range toggles (5D, 20D, 60D, 1Y, YTD), and streak callouts.

key_modules_hierarchy.title: Flow Persistence & Strength Score Radar
key_modules_hierarchy.description: Calculates rolling 5D/20D sums, consecutive buy/sell streak counters, Z-score flow velocity, and institutional absorption meters.

key_modules_hierarchy.title: FII Flow vs Market Return Comparison & Correlation Matrix
key_modules_hierarchy.description: Dual-axis time series and scatter correlation plot comparing FII Net Flows against NIFTY 50/500 returns, including Pearson R correlation coefficient.

key_modules_hierarchy.title: Data Provenance, Methodology, Disclaimer & CSV Export
key_modules_hierarchy.description: Complete breakdown of NSDL/NSE data lag, calculations (Z-score, Rolling Sums), non-recommendation disclaimers, and 1-click CSV export.

visual_enhancers.surface_style: Dark obsidian glassmorphic card with subtle 1px border (#232B3E) and soft hover glow
visual_enhancers.chart_tooltips: Dark custom tooltip with monospaced numbers, precise currency formatting (₹ Cr), and data freshness tags
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle Framer Motion entrance fades (duration 0.2s), tab transitions, smooth hover scale on cards

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly follow dark mode guidelines with crisp slate borders (#232B3E) and rich dark surfaces (#0F131C, #161B26).
DO NOT hardcode fake stock advice or claims that FII buying predicts guaranteed stock price gains. Include disclaimers prominently.
Place a Data Provenance Chip on EVERY visual card showing: Source, Data Date, Last Updated, Frequency, and Quality Indicator.
Ensure Sector Flow is highlighted as the primary view with top priority in layout.
Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font for all financial figures, percentages, ₹ Cr values, and timestamps.
All buttons, inputs, tabs, export options, and chart controls MUST have data-testid attributes for automated verification.
